story: Explore the fascinating world of the Crimson Backed Flameback (Megaceryle lugubris). Classified under the Alcedinidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits mountain rivers;fast-flowing streams;wooded riverbanks. The current IUCN classification of Least Concern (LC) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Crimson Backed Flameback is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the Crimson Backed Flameback, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
